The price a stock kept coming down to and turning back from, without closing under it, is its support: sellers couldn\'t push the price below it. The older the support (full points at 6 months) and the more times it was tested (full at 5), the more points it adds to the score; a stock without support loses no points. Choose \"Support scan\" above to see only the stocks that never closed under their support in 6 months, and whose support has held at least %1$d months and been tested at least 3 times. The Support scan has its own Filters, apart from the Breakout scan\'s. Both scans read the same data, so one scan refreshes both lists.
